title: wiretap: pcap[ng]: Don't let the reported length underflow w/ phdr
description:
pcap_process_pseudo_header is passed in the captured length, so it
should *never* return a pseudo header length longer than the captured
length; if it does, that's an internal libwiretap error.

If the reported length is less than the captured length, it's possible
that subtracting the pseudoheader length could underflow. Set the
reported length to zero in that case; the frame dissector will fix it
up and add an expert info (assuming that the capture length is
positive.)

Fix #21227

AI-Assisted: no
